senses.gloss: ch. same, the office of the Nasi, the house of the Nasi.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:7">Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דשרון גרמון מן נ׳ וכ׳</he> who resigned from the Nasiate and appointed him (Hillel) &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מנשיאותיה</he> (corr. acc.) Y. Sabb. XII, 93ᶜ bot. <he>אתחתנון בנ׳</he> they married into the Nasi family. Y. Peah III, 21ᵃ bot.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ביתא דנְשִׂיּוּתָה הוא משועבד הוא לנישיותה</he> it is the Nasi’s official residence, and is pledged to those who occupy the office (and the widow must leave); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:3">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top <cite ref="N01297"><he>נשוותא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:13">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> <he>אילין דנַשְׂיָתָא</he> those of the family of the Nasi.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:16:3">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite> <he>ניסיותיה</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="H01903"><he>חֲתַן</he></cite>.
